## Real-intake cafe concept preview: Case Study Coffee Roasters (2026-10-23)

- User requested a real Portland cafe intake, researched with the builtin browser

- Intake issue #185; creative-only run 39971574919 on the pinned

## Preview email hits legacy Cloudflare Access (2026-10-23T14:27Z)

- **Task:** Diagnose why preview emails still ask for the old Cloudflare
  one-time PIN after the Neon admin-auth cutover, and fix the link so it uses
  the app's current auth. **Nifty:** parent `DSOvmK3Esb`; subtasks
  `FyCYy5MdJr` (reproduce/confirm), `wc!m6mE1sF` (implement), `7k5G9mGGAx`
  (verify), `cV4xwxGsQV` (integrate). **Branch/worktree:**
  `codex/launchloom-preview-auth` at
  `/home/zahemen/.local/share/opencode/worktree/1582b5/launchloom-preview-auth`,
  created from `origin/main` `2f160ed1`.
- **Root cause confirmed:** the notification email from focused test profiles
  contains the raw immutable Pages URL under
  `*.launchloom-pipeline-preview.pages.dev`. That host is still covered by the
  one remaining legacy Cloudflare Access application
  (`launchloom-maigreeks.cloudflareaccess.com`). Access terminates the request
  before the site or Worker runs, so the Neon session on
  `api.launchloom.wrazyos.com` cannot satisfy it. This is the only remaining
  account Access app per the 2026-10-21 cutover entry.
- **Evidence:** anonymous `GET
https://review-initial.launchloom-pipeline-preview.pages.dev/` returns HTTP
  302 to `https://launchloom-maigreeks.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/login/...`;
  a live 2026-10-22 focused-run email carried
  `https://63ae786d.launchloom-pipeline-preview.pages.dev`
  (`scripts/run-pipeline-test.mjs` `sendPipelineTestNotification`). Client
  review previews such as
  `https://review-initial.launchloom-93-juniper-grove-estate-law.pages.dev/`
  return HTTP 200 with no Access redirect. The Worker route
  `/admin/onboarding-invites` now returns the Neon login redirect, not Access.
- **Why it keeps happening:** the focused-test lane deliberately keeps Access
  (docs/focused-pipeline-tests.md and `assertTestPreviewAccessPolicy`), but its
  developer email releases the bare protected URL. Nothing in that path mints
  or carries an app session.
- **Decision pending:** whether to proxy protected previews through the
  Neon-authenticated Worker (keeps Access, no Cloudflare dashboard change), make
  focused previews unlisted/public like client previews (requires the Access
  app to be removed or bypassed), or link emails to the authenticated admin
  workspace only. No implementation or external Access change made yet.

### Authenticated preview proxy implemented (2026-10-23T14:48Z)

- **Decision:** the user chose the Neon-authenticated Worker proxy, preserving
  the existing Access protection and requiring no Cloudflare dashboard change.
- **Worker:** new `worker/src/preview-proxy.ts` plus shared contract
  `src/lib/preview-proxy-contract.mjs`. Route
  `GET|HEAD /admin/preview/<pages-host>/<path>` verifies the active Neon session
  and membership, fetches the preview with the Access service token, rewrites
  same-site HTML/CSS/redirects, strips browser cookies and upstream
  `Set-Cookie`, and serves the document under a CSP `sandbox` opaque origin so
  generated-site scripts cannot reach admin APIs with the operator's cookies.
  Only `*.pages.dev` (or `PREVIEW_PROXY_HOSTS`) is fetchable; userinfo, ports
  and non-HTTPS targets are rejected. Missing service credentials fail closed
  with `502`, never the Access login page.
- **Links:** `scripts/preview-link.mjs` probes a developer preview and selects
  the proxy only when Access intercepts it. `send-preview-email.mjs` applies it
  to developer-facing audiences only; `run-pipeline-test.mjs` applies it to
  focused-test notifications; `src/admin/format.ts` `previewHref()` applies it
  to workspace preview links. Production links stay direct.
- **Deployment:** `deploy-platform.yml` installs
  `CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID`/`SECRET` as Worker secrets when present;
  workflow jobs receive `LAUNCHLOOM_ADMIN_ORIGIN` from `ADMIN_PUBLIC_ORIGIN`.
- **Docs:** new `docs/preview-access.md`; focused-test setup updated.
- **Focused validation so far:** `worker/test/preview-proxy.test.ts` 14 passed
  (including router wiring); `tests/preview-link.test.ts` 11 passed;
  `tests/pipeline-test-runner.test.ts` + `tests/admin-view-model.test.ts` 86
  passed; `npm run check:worker` clean; `npm run check` 0 errors (5 pre-existing
  hints); `npm run build:admin` and `npm run build` completed.
- **PR:** [#186](https://github.com/WrazyAI/launchloom/pull/186) opened from
  `codex/launchloom-preview-auth` after rebasing onto `origin/main` `9e91ea94`.
  Commit `4df6d9f4`. No Cloudflare Access application or dashboard setting was
  changed.
- **Additional evidence:** the live link selector returns the proxy URL for
  `review-initial.launchloom-pipeline-preview.pages.dev` and the direct URL for
  the public Juniper Grove client preview. A developer-email envelope render
  (no send) contains
  `https://api.launchloom.wrazyos.com/admin/preview/review-initial.launchloom-pipeline-preview.pages.dev/?review=...`
  with no Access hostname; a client-email envelope stays direct. The full worker
  suite reached 344/345 with a 30 s timeout; the single `admin-neon-auth`
  timeout passed when rerun alone. Production readback still pending.
